structured.answer: A money-market fund (קרן כספית) holds short, low-risk stuff, pays about 3.25% a year before tax and fees (my current account pays 0%, a 12-month deposit 1.8%), and you can pull money out any trading day. So it suits money I might need soon, but the page never told me in a number what it costs me.

stuck.why: I was looking for a fee number. Every row just says 'אין תקרה בחוק' plus codes, so I still don't know what I'd pay
The only fee number I saw was 0.1%, and I couldn't tell if that's what I pay or a 'עמלת הפצה' the bank gets
15% for the deposit vs 25% for the fund looked like the fund is worse on tax; didn't get 'ריאלי'
Nothing tells me which fund to pick or what to do first

findings.what: The cost section has no numbers at all. Every row says 'אין תקרה בחוק', so I left still not knowing what it costs
The same rule codes (MF-20, BANK-18, BRK-16…) repeat on every row, and I had to read through them each time to find what's different
The only fee percent (0.1%) is buried in a long paragraph and seems to be what the bank gets, not what I pay
Tax is confusing: 15% for the deposit vs 25% for the fund made the fund look worse
The opening text is packed with words I don't know (נאמן, מק"מ, מפיץ, השעה היעודה)
'אין ערבות של המדינה… אין ביטוח' is scary and isn't weighed against how low the risk actually is
No next step: no fund named, no 'start here'
3.25% is 'לפני מס ועלויות', but the page never shows what's left after those
